provenance.leakage_gate: not applicable: no model feature values are used or written

data.lab_method: Commits made within two minutes of each other form one batch, because the work was committed in batches. A batch's work time is the gap since the previous commit, capped at an hour because longer gaps hold pipeline runs or breaks, and it is split between arms by their share of the code lines the batch changed. The upper bound gives each arm the whole capped window of every batch that touched its files. Arm A owns the shared tabular pipeline, which B and D reuse, so B and D are counted for what they add; Gate 2 counts under B, whose graph features it exists to test.
data.lab_caveat: The repository was built with an AI coding assistant in a two-day sprint, so lab time is far below what a team would need and says little about production cost.

A.basis: Engineer-days for a first production version: feature pipeline from existing data, tuned boosted model, batch scoring, monitoring and model governance. Unsourced range suggested by the coding assistant.

B.basis: Added to A: link features or a graph store, kept fresh and computed point-in-time so they cannot leak, and operational on-call. Unsourced range suggested by the coding assistant.

D.basis: Added to A: a GNN training pipeline, scoring new nodes as they arrive, explanations for investigators and model risk review. Unsourced range suggested by the coding assistant.

data.production_source: 03-the-margin/build-days.csv, adopted by the author; each basis says where it came from
